climate: Summers are close to rainless. Vines draw on water stored in the soil, or on irrigation, but disease is rare.

blurb.text: A small 2,300 acre AVA at the southern end of Cienega Valley in San Benito County. Summer days run 85 to 95°F with up to 50°F swings, on sandy, gravelly loam over limestone and dolomite. Old vine Mourvedre and Zinfandel grow here.
